svg.title: Progaminfinite: collectible studio with Darth Vader display
svg.desc: Warm garage studio with Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Spider-Man, Iron Man and Captain America miniatures added to the highest shelf. Darth Vader stands on the right-hand tabletop in a glass display case with a glowing red lightsaber. The original room and its existing collection are preserved.

g.title: Darth Vader action figure in a glass display case
g.desc: A poised black-armored miniature with an extended Force hand and an ignited glowing red lightsaber, standing in a clear glass box on the right-hand tabletop.
